properties.site-address: Horley Police Station, Massetts Road, Horley
properties.notes: Borough Local Plan (2005) policy Cf1 resists the loss of community buildings or uses unless there is no longer a need for them, or adequate alternative provision is to be made elsewhere in the locality and no other community facility or service can make use of the premises or site. The site is owned by the Police Crime Commissioner for Surrey. The landowner has indicated that the site is no longer required for operational purposes. The site has been identified in the Regulation 19 Development Management Plan for housing development.
